purpose: v1.3 candidate quality gate; production stays v1.2

training.iterations: Both exploratory iterations retained. Dirty source at run time: not frozen acceptance evidence.

gates.testsAndPrivacy: all pass; no unresolved blocking review issues
gates.versusV12: score >= 0.55, seed-cluster bootstrap lower bound >= 0.45, each lineup >= 0.45
gates.truncation: <= 1% per pair; counted as half score, never called a win
gates.ablation: report every result; do not infer causality from one matchup

constraints: Freeze source before acceptance; no weight changes based on acceptance outcomes
A failed gate does not promote the candidate; retain evidence and reserve fresh seeds for later iterations
Six seed clusters and three rosters are limited evidence, not human-strength validation
Style opponents share legality and mandatory-rule helpers but use separate action/response scores
Telemetry is diagnostic: burden/idle energy use declared heuristic definitions, not ground-truth regret
